integrity: The all-integer conclusion uses an explicit Laplacian pseudoinverse proof and full current-sign classification; finite exact-rational tests corroborate but do not establish it. The cited first-public source is the motivating Banach-space projection framework, not a prior statement of this formula.
scientific_limitations: Canonical Euclidean-orthogonal cut and cycle projections on uniform unweighted independent-fiber blow-ups of cycles of length at least five; no minimum norm among arbitrary projections or intermediate-exponent theorem. There may be less-indexed equivalent electrical-network literature.
title: Exact endpoint cut and cycle norms for cyclic independent-fiber graph blow-ups
